topic: Latest Trends in AI Coding Assistants for Senior Developers
executive_summary: AI coding assistants have crossed from early-adopter novelty to table-stakes infrastructure. In 2026, 77-92% of developers use these tools daily, the market has tripled to $11.7B, and the center of gravity has shifted from line-by-line autocomplete to autonomous agentic workflows. Senior developers report 81% productivity gains, but the same tools are flooding production with vulnerable code — AI-attributed CVEs grew 6x between January and March 2026. The senior engineer role is being redefined from 'writing code' to 'orchestrating agents,' while junior roles face contraction.
